subject: Co-sell demo: Sigma Retail + SI Partners — triple-cloud showcase
messages:
From: Arjun Mehta <arjun.mehta@si-partners.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: priya.r@aws-partner.com, ops@sigmaretail.com
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 21:12:00 -0700
Subject: Co-sell demo: Sigma Retail + SI Partners — triple-cloud showcase

Hi Kimberly & Vanessa,

Thanks for the intro. Sigma Retail is eager to see a joint showcase of Redwood running across AWS, Azure, and GCP — with our SI team (SI Partners) handling the implementation narrative. Proposed scope: 45–60 minute customer-facing demo (technical + business outcomes) followed by a 20–30 minute Q&A focused on deployment and cost controls. We also want a 15–30 minute rehearsal with engineering leads.

Potential windows (PDT):
- Tue Apr 18 — 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Wed Apr 19 — 15:00–16:30 or 16:30–18:00

Attendees from our side: Arjun Mehta (SI Partners), Priya R. (AWS technical partner lead, cc'd), and two Sigma ops folks (ops@sigmaretail.com). Can you confirm Redwood hosts and an Azure rep? Also attaching a draft agenda (Sigma-demo-agenda.pdf).

Primary asks:
- Confirm preferred final slot and rehearsal slot
- Primary host + backup host from Redwood
- Any additional runbook or slide requirements

Thanks,
Arjun

Attachment: Sigma-demo-agenda.pdf (1 page stub)
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Arjun Mehta <arjun.mehta@si-partners.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: priya.r@aws-partner.com, ops@sigmaretail.com
Date: Wed, 4 Apr 2028 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-sell demo: Sigma Retail + SI Partners — triple-cloud showcase

Arjun — thanks for the clear scoping and the agenda. We can definitely run a joint session. Quick responses:

- Host options: I can be primary host for the product walkthrough; Vanessa can co-host the deployment & business outcomes. Sergio (cc'd below) will be backup and handle marketplace listing questions.
- Preferred format: 60 min demo + 30 min Q&A gives the customer more runway; happy to shorten if they prefer 45 + 20.
- Rehearsal: we recommend 30 minutes with the technical leads.

Availability (PDT) we can commit to:
- Tue Apr 18: 14:00–15:30 (kimberly) — but Vanessa has a conflict at 10:00
- Wed Apr 19: 15:00–16:30 (both available)

I attached a demo runbook (demo-runbook.xlsx) with roles and minimal slides required. If Priya can confirm AWS speaker availability, we should lock Wed Apr 19 15:00 PDT as the primary. Otherwise, Sergio will stand in for the cloud segment.

Next steps: please confirm final slot and I'll send calendar invites + a short run-of-show doc.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Solutions Partner, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachment: demo-runbook.xlsx (roles & run-of-show, 3 sheets)
From: Priya R. <priya.r@aws-partner.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, arjun.mehta@si-partners.com
Date: Wed, 4 Apr 2028 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-sell demo: Sigma Retail + SI Partners — triple-cloud showcase

Thanks Kim & Arjun — quick update from the AWS side: our lead speaker has a scheduling conflict on Tue Apr 18, but we can cover Wed Apr 19. Preferred AWS windows (PDT):
- Wed Apr 19: 14:30–15:30 OR 15:00–16:00 (we'd prefer a 60-minute contiguous slot if possible).

If you shift to 15:00 PDT start we can prepare a streamlined technical segment (45–50 minutes) and leave 30 minutes for Q&A; otherwise 14:30 start works but will compress the later agenda. We can also pre-record a 5-minute segment for the deep infra dive if timing is tight.

Let me know if you want me to own the AWS technical portion or if Sergio will cover marketplace specifics.

—Priya
Senior Partner Solutions, AWS Partner Network
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 4 Apr 2028 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Roster & run-of-show assignments (Sigma demo)

Kim — quick internal note while we wait for Sigma to confirm:

- I'll take the business outcomes + marketplace listing segment (10m) and moderate Q&A (final 20–30m).
- Karthik — can you prepare 2 slides on autoscaling and cost controls (quantization/ batching recommendations).
- Jonas — you're on live infra for GCP — please have the deployment snippet and a fallback plan slide ready.
- Sergio — be prepared to step in for marketplace/partner listing and to answer procurement marketplace questions.

We should plan a 30-minute rehearsal on Apr 18 if Wed Apr 19 15:00 PDT is locked. I'll build a 15-min dry-run checklist.

Thanks — V

Vanessa Ortiz
Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Arjun Mehta <arjun.mehta@si-partners.com>, Priya R. <priya.r@aws-partner.com>, ops@sigmaretail.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 5 Apr 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Final schedule: Wed Apr 19 15:00 PDT + rehearsal Apr 18 11:00 PDT — please confirm

Team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Proposed final schedule:

- Rehearsal (virtual): Tue Apr 18, 11:00–11:30 PDT — technical leads only
- Customer demo (virtual): Wed Apr 19, 15:00–16:30 PDT — 60 min demo + 30 min Q&A

Attachments: triple-cloud-slide-deck-v2.pptx (primary deck), demo-runbook.xlsx (attached earlier). Please review the run-of-show in slide 2: intro (5m) -> product walkthrough (20m) -> SI implementation narrative (15m) -> cloud deep-dive (10m) -> marketplace & procurement (10m) -> Q&A (30m).

Action items:
- Arjun / Sigma Ops: confirm attendee list and calendar invites for both rehearsal and demo
- Priya / AWS: confirm speaker (if you can't own the full cloud deep-dive we'll accept a 5-min pre-record + Sergio live for marketplace)
- Vanessa / Karthik / Jonas: confirm slides ready by EOD Apr 17 PDT

I'll send calendar invites as soon as I have a confirmation from Sigma and Priya. If anyone needs a shorter format, call it out now — otherwise we'll proceed with the 90-minute slot.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Solutions Partner, Redwood Inference

Attachment: triple-cloud-slide-deck-v2.pptx (40 slides, 8MB placeholder)

Kimberly / Arjun — confirmed. We can do Wed Apr 19 at 15:00 PDT and the rehearsal on Apr 18 at 11:00 PDT. Please send calendar invites and the slide deck; we'll forward any pre-demo questions by EOD Apr 18.
